source_language.description: Which statistical language source_code is written in.

source_code.description: The verbatim .sps syntax or .do file contents to translate.

dataset_path.description: Filename of the CSV the script runs against. The emitted R must read it from the ARENA_DATA environment variable, not from this literal path.

codebook.description: Column dictionary for the dataset, so the translation does not have to guess variable meanings or missing-value codes.

required_statistics.description: The named quantities the emitted R must print in its JSON object. Scoring compares these by name.

analysis_description.description: What the analysis does, including any convention the statistic names leave ambiguous (e.g. that mean_diff is group 1 minus group 2). The arena tests cross-language defaults, not the player's ability to guess sign conventions.
